Board Meetings

How to Watch

  • ACC Livestream – Watch Live
  • ACCTV—ACCTV broadcasts the most recent Board of Trustees meeting on the Wednesday following the monthly meeting at 8 PM. It then reruns every Monday and Wednesday at 8 PM. It’s available on Spectrum and Astound on Channel 19, AT&T U-Verse on Channel 99, and Suddenlink on Channel 6.
  • On-Demand Board of Trustees Panopto Streaming Portal

The Board of Trustees conducts open meetings in accordance with Texas Open Meetings Act.

Effective February 13, 2023, ACC Board meetings will be in Room 2110, Highland Campus, Building 3000, 6101 Highland Campus Drive, Austin, Texas 78752. Occasionally, the location and/or time of the meetings may change. Please check the listing below for the most up-to-date information. 

To request accommodations or for other questions regarding Board of Trustees meetings, contact the Chief of Staff at aaron.henry@austincc.edu.
